name: CreateMailFolder
description: This connector creates a new mail folder in a specified mailbox using the Microsoft Graph API. It allows users to organize their emails by creating custom folders within their mailbox.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: Microsoft 365 Credentials
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credentials to authenticate the API request for creating a new mail folder.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox where the new folder will be created. This should be a valid email address associated with the Microsoft 365 account.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: The display name for the new mail folder. This is the name that will be shown in the mailbox view. It should be a user-friendly name that helps identify the purpose of the folder.

fields.name: IsHidden
fields.label: Hidden Folder
fields.description: Indicates whether the new mail folder should be hidden from the user's mailbox view. If set to true, the folder will not be visible in the mailbox.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Creation Result
fields.description: The result of the mail folder creation operation, including success status and any relevant information or error messages.
